decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel draws directly on the firm's core cryptography and authentication knowledge and fits its push toward binding mobile communication, so its own R&D can keep improving it.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is the conceptual backbone of the integrated offering, and the firm's deep security know-how lets it absorb market feedback and extend it.

The hardware token builds on established authentication and hardware experience and still serves regulated customers who need a separate device, but the shift to app-based authentication keeps its withdrawal risk elevated.

Regulations such as PSD2 keep the compliance suite relevant and the firm's cryptography knowledge supports it, though its narrow compliance scope makes later repackaging into broader offerings plausible.
